blocks.text: Emberbowl keeps the memory of preparing a small warm portion in the shape of a bowl and a curl. It is an everyday care object, not an invitation to infer its effects from heat or color alone.
A folded indigo origami bowl with one copper spiral tucked within and three ivory feet.
One-shot activation: The bowl opens on four folds and the copper spiral rises and loosens. The game performs the final fade.
13 silver. Digestion severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Health +5; Energy +3. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.

Original PixelLab artwork and opening animation, October 28, 2026. Generation 1b4bc956-0774-4ff9-8a55-935d46b80eac; animation 9bf14440-1fa8-4508-88b2-5c292c907142. The game performs the final fade; reduced motion holds a still.
